title: Frequency-Domain Adaptive Filter
text: Compute output, error, and coefficients using frequency domain FIR adaptive filter, 8 inputs, 3 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Initial time-domain coefficients} sets Initial time-domain coefficients of filter; {Method}, {Filter length} sets the length of filter coefficients vector, {Block length}, {Specify step size from port} sets the flag to specify step size, {Step size} sets the adaptation step size, {Specify leakage factor from port} sets the flag to specify leakage factor, {LeakageFactor} sets the adaptation leakage factor, {Specify averaging factor from port} sets the flag to specify averaging factor, {Averaging factor}, {Specify offset from port} sets the flag to specify offset, {Offset}, {Initial FFT input signal power}, {Enable adapt port} sets the flag to enable coefficient update, {Enable reset port} sets the flag to reset internal states, {Output filter FFT coefficients} sets the flag to output the DFT of the filter and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
